name: Securities Settlement Transaction Modification Request Status Advice 002 V 06
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a SecuritiesSettlementTransactionModificationRequestStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of a SecuritiesSettlementModificationRequest message previously sent by the account owner.|The account servicer may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure managing securities settlement transactions on behalf of their participants|- an custodian acting as an accounting and/or settlement agent.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

ModificationRequestReference.name: Modification Request Reference
ModificationRequestReference.definition: Reference to the unambiguous identification of the cancellation request as per the account owner.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
